title: Stress-induced Bacillus subtilis DLD-8 volatiles enhance drought tolerance in mung bean via 2,3-butanediol-MYB interaction.
authors: Bhavya, Koli; Aggarwal, Chetana; Kundu, Aditi; Paul, Bishwajeet; Gundreddy, Raja Reddy; Yadav, Yamini; Sowmya, Pallaganti; Paul, Sangeeta
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芽孢杆菌挥发性物质2,3-丁二醇与绿豆MYB蛋白的分子对接，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法仅为初步对接，与TF-DNA结合机制课题关联较弱。
abstract: Drought is major abiotic constraint limiting mung bean (Vigna radiata L. Wilczek) productivity. Rhizobacterial volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are increasingly being recognized for their role in plant-microbe interactions including growth promotion and stress tolerance. This study evaluated the effects of VOCs on biometric and physiological responses of mung bean under osmotic stress and examined interaction of the most efficient VOC with a MYB protein. VOCs from five rhizobacterial cultures, grown under non-stress and osmotic stress conditions, were assessed in vitro and in vivo. VOCs from three cultures significantly enhanced plant biomass, proline accumulation, and SOD activity; with stronger responses observed for VOCs from stressed cultures. Based on its performance, Bacillus subtilis DLD-8 was selected for detailed analysis. GC-MS profiling detected 36 VOCs under stress and 24 under non-stress, with stressed cultures enriched in alkanes and alcohols. VIP-based analysis identified 2,3-butanediol, tetradecane, and octadecane as key volatiles. Pathway enrichment indicated stress-induced activation of tyrosine and benzoate metabolism, while non-stressed cultures showed enrichment in lipid and fatty acid metabolism. Network analysis suggested enhanced connectivity of 2,3 butanediol with pyruvate derived intermediates under stress indicating carbon flux redistribution towards the acetoin-2,3-butanediol pathway. In vivo validation, revealed that 2,3-butanediol and the blend of three predominant VOCs elicited the strongest plant responses. Notably, 2,3-butanediol alone outperformed the blend, and enhanced biomass, proline, chlorophyll, and SOD activity. Docking analysis provided preliminary computational evidence of a potential interaction between 2,3-butanediol and Vigna radiata MYB protein, suggesting possible link in MYB-mediated drought stress-responsive pathways.
abstract_zh: 干旱是限制绿豆（Vigna radiata L. Wilczek）生产力的主要非生物胁迫因素。根际细菌挥发性有机化合物（VOCs）在植物-微生物互作中的作用日益受到关注，包括促进生长和增强胁迫耐受性。本研究评估了VOCs在渗透胁迫下对绿豆生物计量和生理响应的影响，并考察了最有效VOC与MYB蛋白的相互作用。在体外和体内条件下，评估了来自五种根际细菌培养物（在非胁迫和渗透胁迫条件下生长）的VOCs。来自三种培养物的VOCs显著增强了植物生物量、脯氨酸积累和SOD活性；其中，来自胁迫培养物的VOCs表现出更强的响应。基于其表现，选择枯草芽孢杆菌（Bacillus subtilis）DLD-8进行详细分析。GC-MS谱图检测到胁迫条件下36种VOCs和非胁迫条件下24种VOCs，胁迫培养物中富集了烷烃和醇类。基于VIP的分析鉴定出2,3-丁二醇、十四烷和十八烷为关键挥发性物质。通路富集分析表明，胁迫诱导了酪氨酸和苯甲酸代谢的激活，而非胁迫培养物则富集了脂质和脂肪酸代谢。网络分析提示，胁迫条件下2,3-丁二醇与丙酮酸衍生中间体的连接性增强，表明碳通量重新分配至乙酰甲基甲醇-2,3-丁二醇通路。体内验证显示，2,3-丁二醇及三种主要VOCs的混合物引发了最强的植物响应。值得注意的是，单独使用2,3-丁二醇的效果优于混合物，并增强了生物量、脯氨酸、叶绿素和SOD活性。分子对接分析提供了2,3-丁二醇与绿豆MYB蛋白潜在相互作用的初步计算证据，提示其可能在MYB介导的干旱胁迫响应通路中发挥作用。
